changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.card_purchases ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, purchased_on date NOT NULL, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, id_invoice bigint NOT NULL, id_classification bigint NOT NULL, id_cost_center bigint NOT NULL, id_movement bigint, CONSTRAINT card_purchases_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT card_purchases_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT card_purchases_id_movement_key UNIQUE (id_movement), CONSTRAINT ck_card_purchases_on_value CHECK (value > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_invoices_on_card_purchases FOREIGN KEY (id_invoice) REFERENCES financial.invoices (id), CONSTRAINT fk_classifications_on_card_purchases FOREIGN KEY (id_classification) REFERENCES registration.classifications (id), CONSTRAINT fk_cost_centers_on_card_purchases FOREIGN KEY (id_cost_center) REFERENCES registration.cost_centers (id), CONSTRAINT fk_movements_on_card_purchases FOREIGN KEY (id_movement) REFERENCES financial.movements (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_card_purchases_on_invoice ON financial.card_purchases (id_invoice); CREATE INDEX ix_card_purchases_on_purchased_on ON financial.card_purchases (purchased_on);
